cues.en: Alliance, Nebraska. This is probably the worst place that you could ever build this. In the winter, we'll get real high winds, lots of dry cold. I think it averages daytime around 30 degrees Fahrenheit. It'll get down to every year, we'll have days that are 25 degrees below zero or lower. Wow, it looks like you even have oranges.
cues.zh: 内布拉斯加州阿莱恩斯。这可能是你能建这个东西的最糟的地方。冬天风特别大，又干又冷。我觉得白天平均在华氏30度左右。每年气温会降到——有些日子会低到零下25华氏度甚至更低。哇，你这里居然还有橙子。

cues.en: Yeah, those are Eureka lemons. These are Valencia oranges. They're the juice orange. This one, it's a new type of mandarin. That doesn't normally grow in Nebraska. The what? Citrus doesn't normally grow in Nebraska. No. No. Nowhere near. The closest ones would be probably 800 miles in Texas or somewhere. And not a problem? No.
cues.zh: 是的，那些是 Eureka 柠檬。这些是 Valencia 橙。它们是榨汁橙。这个嘛，是一种新的柑橘。那种在内布拉斯加通常不生长。什么？柑橘在内布拉斯加通常不生长。不会。不会。差得远。最近的可能在得克萨斯州之类的地方，大约800英里外。这不成问题吗？没问题。

cues.en: No, in fact, they thrive here. We can probably grow the best citrus anywhere in the world at this latitude for size and quality. These are 12-month greenhouses. We're wasting our sunshine in Nebraska during the winter. We're not growing. And we're just wasting all of this underground heat. This is one of the tubes coming out of the ground. Six-inch tubes that go down eight foot deep and out.
cues.zh: 不，其实它们在这里长得很好。在这个纬度上，我们大概能种出全世界个头最大、品质最好的柑橘。这些是全年运行的温室。冬天在内布拉斯加，我们浪费了阳光。我们没在种植，还白白浪费了所有这些地下热量。这是从地下伸出来的一根管子。六英寸粗的管子，向下深入八英尺，再向外延伸。

cues.en: and clear out into the yard. See where that asparagus is back there? It goes out about 90 foot back there and then comes around and goes in. There's seven of them coming up on the south side here. We're just using the underground heat. Underground it stays a certain temperature? It's stable at 52 degrees here. So if you have a stable temperature you can use that both in winter and summer? Yeah and this
cues.zh: 然后一直通到院子里。看到后面那片芦笋了吗？它向外延伸大约90英尺，然后绕回来再进入地下。南侧这里伸出地面的一共有七根。我们只是在利用地下热量。地下温度是恒定的吗？这里稳定在52华氏度。所以如果温度稳定，冬天和夏天都能利用？对，而且这个

cues.en: Blower here this sets over seven tubes six inch tubes that go down eight foot deep and then when the blower goes on it just recirculates that air Continually when and picks up that ground heat So you're just the energy you're using is just to circulate the ground. Yeah, just circulates the the air underground It only runs when it's 50 degrees or lower it draws seven and a third amps
cues.zh: 这里的鼓风机连接着七根六英寸的管子，向下深入八英尺；鼓风机一启动，就会不断让空气循环，吸收地下的热量。所以你消耗的能量只是用来循环地下空气。对，就是让空气在地下循环。它只在华氏50度或更低时运行，电流为7⅓安培。

cues.en: and that heats the entire place during the winter. But just about everything we put in grows real well. These are figs here, and they'll put up this first crop. Then in the middle of the summer, they'll put out another crop that's way heavier. Here's some grapes, and those are golden muskot. We've got, I think, nine different varieties of grapes.
cues.zh: 冬天它能给整个地方供暖。不过我们种进去的几乎所有东西都长得很好。这些是无花果，它们会先结出第一茬果。到了盛夏，它们还会再结一茬，产量高得多。这里有一些葡萄，那些是 Golden Muscat。我想我们有九个不同品种的葡萄。

cues.en: They're all southern grapes. Northern grapes, they'll grow in here, but they won't fruit. These are Thompson seedless. We're having to learn how to grow grapes because it doesn't work the same here that it does outdoors. So all you did in order to have this plenty was to take advantage of the sun and to go a little bit deeper into the ground and to combine the two things together? Yeah.
cues.zh: 这些都是南方葡萄。北方葡萄在这里能长，但不会结果。这些是 Thompson 无核葡萄。我们得学着怎么种葡萄，因为这里和露天种植不一样。所以你能有这么多收成，全靠利用阳光、往地下再深一点，把这两样结合起来？对。

cues.en: Everything in the design fits together. You can't do away with any part of it and come up with this efficiency. The sloped back wall, this one's so overgrown now that it doesn't make any difference, but in the new ones, when the sun goes low in winter, that wall will reflect down on the growing beds.
cues.zh: 设计里的每样东西都相互配合。去掉任何一部分，都不可能达到这种效率。倾斜的后墙——这一栋现在长得太满，已经看不出差别了，但在新建的温室里，冬天太阳角度低时，那面墙会把阳光反射到种植床上。

cues.en: You don't get it growing raised from the north, so there's no reason to have glazing on the north. So we get all of our sun from the south and above. This is all Lexan. It's polycarbonate. It's 3-eighths inch thick, and this is twin wall. It has a little insulation value, not very much. But in the back wall, this is the only one that has this open foam.
cues.zh: 北边采不到光，所以北面没必要装玻璃。我们所有的阳光都来自南面和上方。这全是 Lexan，是聚碳酸酯，厚 3/8 英寸，这是双层中空板。它有一点保温效果，但不大。不过后墙这一块是唯一用了开孔泡沫的。

cues.en: All the rest of them have galvanized metal. These are the little flame grapes, and then too we've got blackberries there. Yeah, there's a pomegranate there. Let's see, are there any fresh blossoms? Here's one, and then here's some more. We can grow local plants, and we can grow tropical plants, but sometimes local plants don't like it as well.
cues.zh: 其余的全是镀锌金属。这些是小火焰葡萄，那边还有黑莓。对，那儿有一棵石榴。看看，有没有新开的花？这儿有一朵，这儿还有更多。我们可以种本地植物，也可以种热带植物，但有时候本地植物没那么喜欢这里。

cues.en: This tree is about 24 years old. It'll probably grow for another 100 years or so. When we built the greenhouse was the year I retired from the post office. So this unit's about 24 years old. So you initially had geothermal just for the house? Yeah. When we built the house 45 years ago, we took tubes out through the lawn that are eight foot deep and they just...
cues.zh: 这棵树大约24年了。它可能还会再长100年左右。我们建温室那年，正好是我从邮局退休的那年。所以这个温室大概24年了。所以你们最初只给房子做了地热？对。45年前建房子的时候，我们把管子铺到草坪下面，有八英尺深，它们就……

cues.en: circulate that 52 degree temperature. This is the geothermal tubes for the house. You can tell there's a little indentation. It goes right down through here and then it goes into that patio area, three different points. We found out it worked so well for the house that we could use it for the greenhouse without the heat pump. This one is three and a half years old.
cues.zh: 循环那股52华氏度的温度。这些是给房子用的地热管。你能看出来这里有点凹陷。它就从这儿往下穿过去，然后通到那个露台区域，分三个点。我们发现它给房子用效果特别好，所以温室不用热泵也能用。这一套已经三年半了。

cues.en: It's called a tango mandarin. I'll pick that one. Let me see. When we started it, we knew it would work, but we didn't know how well. And we knew that we had to grow something that you couldn't grow here. So that's why we ended up with a citrus. And I think we have 13 different varieties now. All of them thrive. Most all of the fruit is way bigger than...
cues.zh: 它叫 Tango 柑橘。我就选那个。让我看看。我们开始种的时候，知道它会成功，但不知道效果会有多好。我们也知道，得种一种这里种不了的东西。所以我们最后选了柑橘。我想现在我们有 13 个不同品种。它们全都长得好。几乎所有果实都比……

cues.en: One fellow that had done work in New Zealand, the only thing he could figure was that it was the latitude. But each one of these trees take up an eight-foot circle at the farmer's market price that we get. The tree will average about 125 pounds of fruit a year. And at farmer's market, that eight-foot circle will return $430. And we grow above and below the
cues.zh: 有一个在新西兰做过研究的人，他唯一能想到的原因就是纬度。但这些树每棵都占一个直径八英尺的圆形地块，按我们拿到的农夫市集价格算。每棵树平均一年产约 125 磅果实。而在农夫市集，这个八英尺的圆能带来 430 美元回报。而且我们在上方和下方都种

cues.en: trees. This greenhouse, this one, averages about 80 cents a day year-round for energy. And the new design is way more efficient than this. We always think we've gone about as far as we can with the efficiency, but I can see the time when we could grow all of the table citrus on the high plains.
cues.zh: 树。这个温室，就这一个，全年平均每天能源花费约 80 美分。新设计比这个高效得多。我们总以为效率已经做到极限了，但我能预见有一天，我们能在高平原种出所有鲜食柑橘。

cues.en: to take care of this whole area. The average grower in Florida gets 46 cents a pound for oranges. We get 350. So they're wholesaling them to a broker and the broker is selling them to a distributor that they have to truck them from 1,500 miles. The profit that we get off of one tree, they're going to have to have nine trees. People say,
cues.zh: 来打理这一整片地方。佛罗里达普通种植户每磅橙子只能拿到 46 美分，我们能拿到 350 美分。他们把橙子批发给经纪人，经纪人再卖给分销商，还得从 1500 英里外运过来。我们一棵树赚到的利润，他们得靠九棵树才能赚到。人们说，

cues.en: that young person can't get into farming anymore because it's too expensive. For the price of a three-year-old four-wheel drive big tractor like they have to have now, we could build nine of these for that price. I don't know how this is going to be today, how hot it's going to be in there because we just got it started and then they went to Australia for two weeks and she wasn't used to watering.
cues.zh: 那个年轻人再也进不了农业这行了，因为成本太高。现在他们非得有那种大型四轮驱动拖拉机，一台用了三年的这种拖拉机，价钱都够我们建九个这样的了。我不知道今天会怎么样，里面会有多热，因为我们刚把它弄起来，然后他们就去澳大利亚待了两周，而她又不习惯浇水。

cues.en: Yep, she's watering now. We just finished building it about two weeks ago. They're so much cheaper than a conventional greenhouse. We tell people if they have access to a backhoe and can do their own labor, which is easy because it just all slips together. It took two out of six hours to put the frame up. We tell people they can put one up completely automated for less than $25,000.
cues.zh: 对，它现在正在浇水。我们大约两周前刚把它建好。它们比传统温室便宜多了。我们告诉大家，只要有反铲挖掘机、能自己出力，就很容易，因为它全是拼插起来的。搭框架花了六个小时中的两个小时。我们告诉大家，不到 25,000 美元就能建一个全自动的。

cues.en: what they would put for the heat system in a regular greenhouse. That nozzle works pretty good, doesn't it? Yeah. About less than three weeks for the plants. And they took a shock when we first put them in.
cues.zh: 也就是普通温室供暖系统的投入。那个喷嘴挺好用的，对吧？是的。植物大概不到三周。我们第一次把它们放进去时，它们受了点刺激。

cues.en: They're really starting to go. And these up here, I can't believe how much they run. So do you want to have, is this sort of a backyard garden idea as well, to have your own produce? Oh yeah. And experimenting. Boy, these things are really taking off, haven't they? Yeah, they're really starting to go. Yeah. Because that's faster than, wouldn't that be faster than just in the ground? Yeah, yeah. I've planted some outside to...
cues.zh: 它们真的开始猛长了。上面这些，我真不敢相信它们长得这么快。那你是想……这也算是一种后院菜园的想法吗，自己种点菜？哦对。还有做试验。天哪，这些东西真是长得飞快，对吧？是啊，它们真的开始猛长了。对。因为那样更快，难道不比直接种在地里更快吗？对，对。我在外面也种了一些，想……

cues.en: experiment to see which ones have done the best. These are way, way ahead of the ones outside. That's the geothermal tubes. They go 75 foot out, 75 foot across, and 75 foot back into the other end. So you've got 230 feet of tube, 8 foot deep.
cues.zh: 实验就是为了看看哪种做得最好。这些比外面的那些领先太多了。这就是地热管。它们往外伸75英尺，横穿75英尺，再从另一端往回走75英尺。所以一根管子一共230英尺，埋深8英尺。

cues.en: At that length of tube, we found that we have enough length in the ground to pick up the whole 52 degrees. It's stable at 52 degrees here. Some places it's down to 48, 49. Some places, like the one up at Black Hawk, it's 62 because they're next to some warm springs. So if you have a stable temperature, you can use that both in winter and summer. Yeah, we could use it for cooling now.
cues.zh: 用这么长的管子，我们发现地下的长度足以把整整52华氏度都吸收上来。这里稳定在52度。有些地方低到48、49度。有些地方，比如Black Hawk那儿的，是62度，因为旁边有温泉。所以只要温度稳定，冬天夏天都能用。对，现在就可以用来制冷了。

cues.en: That's what it's actually doing. I'll show you what that peak is now. Okay, it's 125 degrees. It's coming out at 87 degrees. So it's really circulating. See where that white box is at the other end? That's where all the 17 tubes come up. And they just circulate through. But we're trying to figure out whether it works better to push.
cues.zh: 这就是它实际在做的事。我现在给你们看看那个峰值是多少。好，是125度。出来时是87度。所以它确实在循环。看到另一端那个白盒子在哪儿了吗？17根管子都在那里上来。然后它们就直接循环流过。但我们想弄清楚，是往里推效果更好，

cues.en: like this one's pushing, or pull air like this one is. So when we find that out, we'll use whichever is the most efficient. You've got two thermostats. One goes on when it hits 80 degrees, it'll go on for the cooling. When it drops to 50 degrees, it'll be for the warming in the winter. So you've got a 30 degree temperature range in there where there's no fans on at all.
cues.zh: 像这个是在推，还是像这个一样抽空气。等我们弄清楚了，就用最高效的那种。你有两个恒温器。一个在达到80度时启动，是用来制冷的。当降到50度时，是用来冬天供暖的。所以里面有个30度的温度范围，在这个范围内风扇完全不开。

cues.en: so you're not using any energy during that time in the winter. I was a straight D student, but the only class that I really liked was physics, and a lot of this is nothing but high school physics. That's a model of the new type. See, our blower is at this end. Then the tubes come out here and they go anywhere outside.
cues.zh: 所以冬天那段时间你完全不用耗能。我以前成绩全是D，但唯一真正喜欢的课是物理，而这里面很多不过是高中物理。这是新型号的模型。看，我们的鼓风机在这一端。然后管子从这里出来，通向外面各处。

cues.en: 230 foot and then they come up down in there and so four of them would come in on this side and then we've got two on this side and those tubes they go out eight foot deep 83 feet they come up right in this bucket here eventually it's going to have a better lid on it see there this goes from here into that entry room
cues.zh: 230英尺，然后它们从那里上下穿过；所以四根会从这边进来，这边还有两根；这些管子埋深8英尺、延伸83英尺，最后正好从这个桶里冒出来。以后上面会装个更好的盖子。看，这个从这里通到那个入口房间。

cues.en: and it has a blower and those are high pressure blowers. See this one is the one that has the underground tubes that will cool it in the winter. This room is completely isolated and closed. In the winter when it gets hot in here this blower comes on and if it's all closed it causes a vacuum and it sucks this air underground and it's pre-cooled and then it'll go in here.
cues.zh: 它有一个鼓风机，那些是高压鼓风机。看，这个就是带有地下管道的，冬天会用它来降温。这个房间完全隔离并封闭。冬天这里变热时，这个鼓风机就会启动；如果全部封闭，就会形成真空，把空气吸到地下，预冷后再进入这里。

cues.en: We suck the air off of the peak, off of the peak. That tube takes that hot air off of the top here and it puts it in. It comes down and it's a foot deep underground here. Down about a foot deep along here. Comes up and goes back in up there. And then the blower just blows back. It just recirculates that heat and puts it in the ground.
cues.zh: 我们把空气从顶部抽走，从顶部抽走。那根管子把顶上这部分热空气带走，再送进去。它往下走，在这里埋到地下约一英尺深。沿着这一带往下大约一英尺深。再上来，从上面那边回去。然后风机就把它吹回去。它就是把热量循环起来，送进地里。

cues.en: So in the winter time, we store that amount of heat in the path so we think we can delay the fans coming on a couple hours at night. This is going to be a pond. It'll have 1,220 gallons of water in it, and we'll put fish in it, we'll float, let us unplanks, and we'll water out of it, out of the pond, because the fish will fertilize it. So aquaponics. So aquaponics.
cues.zh: 所以在冬天，我们把这么多热量储存在通道里，我们觉得这样就能让风扇在夜里晚开几个小时。这里会做一个水池。里面会装 1,220 加仑水，我们会养鱼，在浮板上种菜，还会从池子里取水，因为鱼会给水施肥。所以就是鱼菜共生。就是鱼菜共生。

cues.en: If we had the hydroponics set up, we could go clear to the end with a trough in here and have this all hydroponics flowing from this end back into the pond there. There's a lot of geothermal research going on, but at most all of it's grant research, so the end product is millions of dollars. So it's not for
cues.zh: 如果我们把水培设施搭好，就能一直通到最后，在这里放一条水槽，让所有水培水从这一端流回那边的池塘。现在有很多地热研究在进行，但绝大多数都是靠拨款的研究，所以最终产品要花几百万美元。所以它不是面向

cues.en: market grower like this. But your idea is that people could copy this or use this your research and your creation? Yeah, right now we're working with a company in Dubai and they're interested in seeing from what we've learned if they could use it for cooling. At night does it get cold on the desert? Because at night you would be able to maybe put a little cool air through there.
cues.zh: 像这样的商业种植者。不过你的想法是，人们可以照搬这个，或者用上你的研究和你的创造？对，现在我们正和迪拜的一家公司合作，他们很想看看，能不能把我们学到的东西用于降温。沙漠里晚上会变冷吗？因为晚上也许可以让一点凉空气从那儿通过。

cues.en: It might be that the tubes would need to be longer. I think there would be a way to use these underground tubes to ventilate the whole thing and not use any outside air. Everything is automated. That would be everything. The blowers and everything are on thermostats. We can monitor it all. If we had the right equipment, we could actually turn blowers on and off with the telephone.
cues.zh: 管道可能需要更长。我觉得有办法用这些地下管道给整个设施通风，完全不使用外部空气。一切都是自动化的。大概就这些。鼓风机等设备都由温控器控制。我们可以监控一切。如果有合适的设备，我们其实可以用电话开关鼓风机。

cues.en: And how about pests? We don't have a pest problem at all. The only pests we have are white flies and aphids. And either one of those we can control with horticulture oil. All it is is a refined mineral oil. On a system like this, organic is the only sensible way to go. You can have locally grown organic for the same as you would have.
cues.zh: 那害虫呢？我们完全没有虫害问题。唯一的害虫是白粉虱和蚜虫。这两种都能用园艺油控制。它其实就是精炼矿物油。在这种系统上，有机是唯一合理的选择。你能以同样价格买到本地种植的有机产品。

cues.en: outside if you were using toxic chemicals. The local is really a bigger selling point than organic. In the sand hills, those towns are all drying up. All of these little towns that are drying up have vacant lots with water and power at the lot. And it only makes sense to put these in. One this size...
cues.zh: 在外面，如果你用的是有毒化学品。本地出产其实比有机更有卖点。在沙丘地带，那些小镇都在萎缩。这些正在萎缩的小镇都有空地，地块通水通电。把这些建进去很合理。一个这么大的……

cues.en: Lycote is 140 people. You could just about furnish fresh vegetables year-round for a town that size on just this size. And then with citrus, you'd have even more. Yeah, I don't think he knows how old you are. No. 85. 85? Yeah. Wow. And you're still building? Yeah. Nice. We were retired for several years and then it come to this.
cues.zh: Lycote 有 140 人。就这么大一块地，差不多能全年给那么大的镇子供新鲜蔬菜了。再加上柑橘，就更多了。是啊，我觉得他不知道你多大岁数。不，85 岁。85 岁？是啊。哇。你还在建？是啊。真不错。我们退休了好几年，后来又干上这个了。

cues.en: Do you expect to retire? Not as long as we've got this going. It's getting really interesting now.
cues.zh: 你打算退休吗？只要这事还在继续，就不会。现在越来越有意思了。
